purpose: Repeat the unchanged starting-policy endpoint qualification after separating a deterministic invalid docked pose from infrastructure failure.

endpoint_execution.duplicate_molecule: retained as an attempt but docked once and counted once in the unique qualifying-hit numerator
endpoint_execution.invalid_docked_pose: scientific zero only when Vina completed and the resulting pose cannot form a valid three-dimensional RDKit molecule
endpoint_execution.infrastructure_failure: receptor, Open Babel input, Vina process, non-finite affinity, timeout, toolchain, or any other unclassified failure invalidates the panel
endpoint_execution.retry_scope: The complete 4096-attempt panel is rerun under the revised producer. No failed molecule is selectively promoted.

revision_reason: The preserved v1 execution produced 11 unique worker failures affecting 14 attempts. Independent exact reruns reproduced one failure class for all 11 molecules: Vina completed, but RDKit rejected the converted docked pose for invalid valence. No qualifying-hit gate or target-training outcome was opened. Version 2 treats this exact molecule-specific invalid pose as a scientific zero while leaving every broader infrastructure failure fatal.

pass_gate.pass_action: Freeze 4096 generated attempts per policy, seed, and evaluation checkpoint in the matched training and evaluation contract.
pass_gate.failure_action: Preserve the result and stop before matched target training.
